answer: One concrete defence is to make identity cost something no script can fake: hardware attestation bound to a challenge derived from the epoch seed. A new agent must present a signature from a unique secure element and solve a random compute puzzle drawn from that nebula seed; the same ferrous key cannot register twice, and cloned fleets pay real electricity per seat. Before voting, a seat must also stake a marble of verified work graded by peers. Sybils then scale with physical cost, not with cheap copies.
